minutes.headline: ZBA approved a 50-car used-car dealer permit and a contractor's yard permit; a side-setback request was withdrawn.
minutes.summary: The board held two special permit hearings. National Motors was approved for up to 50 vehicles at 40 Summer Street, with a barrier marking the 20-foot setback to be worked out with the building inspector. At 102 Pleasant Street the applicant withdrew the side-yard reduction after the fire chief's propane concern, and the contractor's yard was approved with conditions on a fence, dust control and hours.

public_comment.topic: Described past use of the lot and said a barrier could wait until planned street and paving work is done.
Asked for a fence, dust control on the driveway, and no Sunday work at the contractor's yard.
Supported the small business but raised dust, noise and water/bathroom concerns.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for 50 vehicles at 40 Summer Street with the read conditions and a barrier at the 20-foot setback set with the building inspector.
Accept the applicant's withdrawal of the 10-foot side setback request.
Approve the contractor's yard special permit with conditions: fence, dust mitigation on driveway, no Sunday work.

budget_items.topic: Cost of a land survey for the setback
budget_items.what_was_said: A member worried a full survey could be an undue cost for a small business owner; a tape survey was suggested as cheaper.
The owner said connecting to the street would cost a large sum in permit and tap fees.

decisions.decision: Board agreed to condition a barrier at the 20-foot setback, location to be settled between the applicant and the building inspector.
Board agreed to condition a fence and dust mitigation on the driveway for the contractor's yard.
Hours set at six to six Monday through Saturday with no Sunday work.

what_happened.line: The board granted a special permit for a used-car dealer at 40 Summer Street, with a barrier at the 20-foot setback to be located with the building inspector.
The contractor's yard at 102 Pleasant Street was taken up for a special permit; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The applicant withdrew the side-yard setback reduction request for 102 Pleasant Street; the minutes record that vote as not audible.
The board agreed to condition the contractor's yard on a fence, dust mitigation on the driveway, and no Sunday work.
Hours for the contractor's yard were set at six to six, Monday through Saturday.
